latestVersion.changelog:
**Skill tencent-mps-intl v1.1.9 changelog:**

- Enforces explicit user confirmation before executing any processing command; always restate the generated command and require user approval ("Proceed?") before submission (cost-control safeguard).
- Strongly recommends running high-cost/parameter-uncertain operations with `--dry-run` first to preview expected charges.
- Adds a new requirements.txt for standardized dependency installation and upgrade instructions.
- Expands/updates supported processing and AIGC features in the description.
- Adds a reference to configure budget alerts and monthly caps in Tencent Cloud Billing Center to help prevent overspending.
- Includes best practices documentation and clarifies dependency management.
